## JsonlFilePaperSessionStore

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.Services.JsonlFilePaperSessionStore</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/Services/JsonlFilePaperSessionStore.cs:32](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/Services/JsonlFilePaperSessionStore.cs#L32).

File-system backed IPaperSessionStore. Each session occupies its own directory under BaseDirectory: {BaseDirectory}/ {sessionId}/ session.json — session metadata, atomically replaced on every change fills.jsonl — one versioned fill claim per line (legacy raw reports still read) fills.applied.jsonl — idempotent apply acknowledgements orders.jsonl — one OrderState JSON object per line (append-only) settlements.jsonl — one daily variation-margin settlement per line (append-only) journal-batches/ — immutable, crash-atomic journal effect receipts Atomic writes for session.json use write-to-temp-then-rename semantics to guard against partial writes on crash. JSONL appends are serialised per base directory inside this process so concurrent callers never interleave partial lines. Exactly one process may write a base directory; cross-process transactional locking is intentionally outside this local-file store&#x27;s contract.

Futures settle daily variation margin instead: no notional moves, only price changes scaled by the multiplier (see ApplyVariationMarginFill and ApplyVariationMarginSettlement). |

## RiskEscalationQueueService

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.Services.RiskEscalationQueueService</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/Services/RiskEscalationQueueService.cs:44](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/Services/RiskEscalationQueueService.cs#L44).

Governed-approval queue for risk escalations: the enforced pre-trade validator parks escalated orders here instead of hard-rejecting them, operators approve or deny with an audited actor and reason, and an approval releases exactly one resubmission of the original order through the same risk gate. Metadata key ApprovalMetadataKey carries the one-shot approval token; consumption verifies the resubmitted order matches the full parked order fingerprint (every routing- and payoff-relevant field) so an approval can never release a different executable order than the risk desk reviewed. Queue transitions persist atomically so parked decisions and armed approvals survive process restarts.

```csharp
public sealed class RiskEscalationQueueService : IRiskEscalationQueue, IAsyncDisposable
```
